summary: Iter 24 retest of FEATURE 3c (APK auto-login via ?ah= query param) + regressions. All 4 test scenarios PASS. Module-load capture of BOOT_AH in AuthContext.js plus query-string-preserving Navigate in App.js successfully solves the React Router strip issue from iter 23. Backend 5/5 pytest cases pass. UI regressions (Yesterday/Today 6+6 boxes, MATKA logo, Telegram popup with Download button) all confirmed. Invalid handoff token handled gracefully (no crash, lands on /signup, no token in localStorage).

issues: Multiple React warnings: 'A props object containing a key prop is being spread into JSX' (originating from dev tooling wrappers — not user-visible, low priority)

critical_code_review_comments: AuthContext.js module-load BOOT_AH capture is correct and robust — evaluates synchronously at JS import time before any React render. Cleanest possible fix for React-Router strip race.
App.js lines 237-238 preserve window.location.search via template-literal Navigate target — redundant but defensive (BOOT_AH already captured before this runs).

Minor: On failed redeem (invalid ?ah=), the bogus ?ah= remains in the URL (only success path strips it). If user hard-reloads, redeem re-attempts and fails again — harmless but adds unnecessary backend traffic. Consider always stripping ?ah= after first attempt regardless of outcome.

Note: BOOT_AH module-level constant means if user navigates client-side (without full reload) to another /?ah=NEW_TOKEN URL, the new token would NOT be redeemed. Acceptable since handoff is intended only for fresh APK launches.
seed_data_creation: Used existing admin user. Generated fresh handoff tokens per test scenario as required (10-min TTL, in-memory).
context_for_next_testing_agent: FEATURE 3c is now fully working end-to-end. Module-load BOOT_AH capture in /app/frontend/src/context/AuthContext.js is the canonical fix; do not refactor it into a useEffect or component-scope variable — React Router will strip the query before render. Backend handoff endpoints are in /app/backend/routes/auth_routes.py with 10-min in-memory TTL — restart of backend will invalidate active tokens. Pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_apk_handoff.py covers create-auth, redeem-success, replay-rejection, missing-token, bogus-token (5 tests, all pass).
